startedBy.speaker: Angeline Morrard
reply: You're a traveller, correct? Have you been to Whiterun?
startedBy.conditions: fn249 == 1; No News is Good News hasn't started; the speaker is Angeline Morrard

startedBy.speaker: Angeline Morrard
startedBy.prompt: I haven't met her, but I could try to get more information.
reply: Oh, that's very sweet of you. Anything you can find out from Captain Aldis would be welcome news.
startedBy.conditions: No News is Good News stage == 5; the speaker is Angeline Morrard
startedBy.source: TIF__000E8BC1.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:0E8BC1 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

movedBy.speaker: Captain Aldis
reply: Her daughter was sent to Whiterun, the skirmishes there have been violent. The Whiterun Legate, he needed to know the Stormcloak positions.
He sent out a party to scout the area. They happened upon a large force... I'm told none of them made it back.
Private Morrard was in that scouting party. Yes, her mother.... Well... She needs to be told.
movedBy.conditions: No News is Good News stage == 10; the speaker is Captain Aldis
movedBy.source: TIF__00034B33.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:034B33 (Narrative Gameplay Consistent Dialogue Tweaks.esp)

startedBy.speaker: Elisif the Fair
startedBy.prompt: It was made by Radiant Raiment.
reply: Oh really? Well you can tell them that I will be putting in a request for a few dresses quite soon.
startedBy.conditions: fn182 == 1; the speaker is Elisif the Fair

startedBy.speaker: Taarie
startedBy.prompt: Sounds easy enough. I'll do it.
reply: Good. Here's the outfit. Try to get Elisif's opinion on it and if she likes it mention it's from Radiant Raiment.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Taarie; Fit for a Jarl stage < 10

startedBy.source: Skyrim.esm:0C7D1C DNAM (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

objective.text: Tell <Alias.ShortName=Questgiver> what <Alias.ShortName=Target> said about the outfit.

movedBy.speaker: Elisif the Fair
movedBy.prompt: It was made by Radiant Raiment.
reply: Oh really? Well you can tell them that I will be putting in a request for a few dresses quite soon.
movedBy.conditions: fn182 == 1; the speaker is Elisif the Fair

startedBy.speaker: Svari
reply: You would do that? That's great. You should go do it right now.
startedBy.conditions: Return to Grace stage < 10; the speaker is Svari

startedBy.source: Skyrim.esm:0C7D42 DNAM (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

firstObjective.text: Speak to <Alias.ShortName=Target> about going to the Temple of Divines.

movedBy.speaker: Greta
reply: Thanks.
movedBy.conditions: Return to Grace stage == 10; the speaker is Greta

startedBy.speaker: Sorex Vinius
startedBy.prompt: I can deliver that for you.
reply: Save me a lot of trouble. Here. Take it to the Blue Palace.

startedBy.speaker: Evette San
reply: Great. Get back to me when you're done and I'll give you something for your time.
startedBy.conditions: The Spiced Wine stage < 10; the speaker is Evette San

firstObjective.text: Convince <Alias=Target> to release the Spiced Wine shipment

objective.text: Tell <Alias.ShortName=Questgiver> that <Alias.ShortName=Target> agreed to release the shipment

movedBy.speaker: Vittoria Vici
movedBy.prompt: I'm sure we can work something out. (<Bribecost> gold)
reply: That would be acceptable. You can tell Evette San her shipment will be brought up to Solitude shortly.
movedBy.conditions: fn654 == 1; The Spiced Wine stage == 10; the speaker is Vittoria Vici

movedBy.speaker: Vittoria Vici
movedBy.prompt: Evette can't afford a tariff. She can barely afford her stand. (Persuade)
reply: I suppose I could make an exception. I do like her Spiced Wine.
Fine, tell Evette San her shipment will be brought up to Solitude shortly.
movedBy.conditions: The Spiced Wine stage == 10; the speaker is Vittoria Vici; GetActorValue >= SpeechEasy (now 25) or fn182 == 1
movedBy.source: TIF__000D69DB.Fragment_0 on INFO Skyrim.esm:0D69DB (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

movedBy.speaker: Vittoria Vici
movedBy.prompt: Sure, I'll pay the tariff. (2000 gold)
reply: You will?
I mean of course you will. You can tell Evette San her shipment will be brought up to Solitude shortly.
movedBy.conditions: the player has at least 2000 gold; The Spiced Wine stage == 10; the speaker is Vittoria Vici

startedBy.speaker: Elisif the Fair
startedBy.prompt: I would be honored to help.
reply: Thank you. It would mean a lot to me.
startedBy.conditions: fn403 >= 1; Elisif's Tribute hasn't started; the speaker is Elisif the Fair

startedBy.speaker: Elisif the Fair
startedBy.prompt: What can I do for you, Jarl?
reply: Falk told me what you did for us at Wolfskull Cave. He says you're someone we can trust.
As you may know, Talos worship is outlawed in the Empire.
When we buried my husband, I made offerings to all the gods... except Talos.
I would like you to take an item of his, a warhorn handed down from his father, and place it at a Shrine of Talos.
startedBy.conditions: fn403 >= 1; Elisif's Tribute hasn't started; the speaker is Elisif the Fair
startedBy.source: TIF__000E73B5.Fragment_1 on INFO Skyrim.esm:0E73B5 (Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
